folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"吕文博被冻结的卡里有20万，盟说可运作取出；鹿岛要15万，卫铁生要5万。"},{"level":2,"text":"钢阳街诊所的器械和精神药物归属未定，马铁鹰提议运出去卖抽10%。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-sack-dollar","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-luokai","title":"狙击手罗凯","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"隐身狙击手向唐索开一枪，击杀吕文博后化黑雾离开。"},{"level":2,"text":"柳拂衣说他是玄盾国际的罗凯，目的是给吕文博灭口，玄盾内部有三四个实验室培育超人。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-crosshairs","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-new-identity","title":"设计院秘书身份","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"盟主给欲子设计院办公室秘书职位：3级身份，每周800元，6点下班。"},{"level":2,"text":"欲子选了楚江西路的小办公室，说养两三个月可到4级，再久到5级。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-id-card","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lushima","title":"鹿岛的招揽","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-063.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"鹿岛是霜月会代表，在铜锅为欲子设局，招揽她。"},{"level":2,"text":"欲子拿到联络点：云里路云里互娱，找鹿岛。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-handshake-angle","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-wei-deal","title":"卫铁生的联手条件","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-056.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-2","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"卫铁生口头同意与唐索对付旧城管委会：黑料归PC，追回的脏钱归卫，仓库各拿各的。"},{"level":2,"text":"卫说管委会欠盟二三十万、贪了千万以上；联络点在滨江绿带，报铁生哥。"}],"fallbackColor":"#7da38a","fallbackIcon":"fa-people-arrows","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-guanwei-map","title":"管委会地下地图","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/shops/20260903/birch-avatar-v1.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"唐索以12000元（3000/6000/3000分摊）买到旧城管委会地下一块的地图，已送达存下。"},{"level":2,"text":"唐索读图后认为可从车库入口进。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-map","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-fangtaian","title":"方泰安","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌说方泰安是旧城管委会主任，曾用义胜盟作黑手套并清理旧帮手。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说手头材料尚不足以证明，周末要想办法与他摊牌。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-landmark","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-fang-guard","title":"方泰安的护卫","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"阿尔坎查到方有玄盾个人金卡，约十八人护卫队。"},{"level":2,"text":"私人聊天形容其随从令人窒息，像消失又出现，断电时发光；未能确认能力与身份。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-user-shield","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-liang-help","title":"梁文川的协助","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-101.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-3","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"梁文川自称追风前执行总裁、现技术高管，送欲子就医并垫付费用。"},{"level":2,"text":"他愿查违规使用机甲者，确认管委会买过设备，但要求实际证据。"}],"fallbackColor":"#9a8fb0","fallbackIcon":"fa-wrench","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-shenxiang","title":"神响之地","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"阿瑶梦中方向指向东南，有人在等她；沈漫建议谨慎看待，也让PC力所能及地帮她。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫推测神响之地在旧城区地下；唐索问闻笙，他回避并否认听过。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-compass","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-ayao-bond","title":"阿瑶的生命绑定","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫在事务所解释：PC与阿瑶存在生命绑定，数据因子是能力来源。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫猜想补完阿瑶可解除绑定。阿瑶被数据生物称为天灾。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-link","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-ayao-school","title":"阿瑶的学校","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-090.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"事务所为阿瑶选学校：外国语、实验学校、财经大学附近公办学校、第三实验。"},{"level":2,"text":"阿瑶说更想留在故城区，能感到神响之地的呼唤更强。凯芙拉决定陪沈漫去第三实验打听。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-school","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-shenman-past","title":"沈漫与朱恒","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-088.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫拿出旧照片，说闺蜜朱恒长得像大版阿瑶，2022年1月14日最后合照后人间蒸发。"},{"level":2,"text":"她在遗物里发现astro gate程序，破解时自毁并夺走她的右手，已追查8年。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-image-portrait","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-shenman-list","title":"沈漫与玄盾私榜","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-088.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说自己在玄盾国际公开榜和私榜上都赫赫有名。"},{"level":2,"text":"她说李好的名字大概在私榜低位，有人出钱通缉。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-ranking-star","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-black-car","title":"无人黑车","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-4","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"5月8日夜事务所外、5月9日夜欲子家对街出现无人驾驶黑色SUV，红外和X光确认无人。"},{"level":2,"text":"追车被红灯和交警截停，车向西消失，车牌全网检索失败。"}],"fallbackColor":"#b09a6e","fallbackIcon":"fa-car","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-lost-ones","title":"迷失者","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-088.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说数据化进入赛博世界后失去自我认知的人是迷失者，对老王头只说是猜测。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫另说：消失者以数据重构再现，约3至4个月器官衰竭；有人掌握规则用于私欲。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-person-circle-question","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-rabbit-hole","title":"兔子洞与红皇后","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"老王头面馆的rh06.1x1程序，时间戳是1970年1月1日，运行后死灵术士钻出。"},{"level":2,"text":"沈漫说程序作者的称号是红皇后；天海电脑上另有rh007.exe。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-rabbit","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-tianhai","title":"天海与追风","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"沈漫说天海是套壳公司，注册资本1200万，员工仅5人，CEO被捕后全部消失。"},{"level":2,"text":"李好查到天海日常资金由追风出行打款；沈漫建议暂不硬查追风。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-sitemap","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-sh-txt","title":"S.H.的TXT","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-072.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"工云广场网吧里，电脑弹出TXT：你们来迟了，看看窗外。"},{"level":2,"text":"落款S.H.，让他们走吧，这里查不到东西了。桌上没有回应。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-terminal","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-sh-heling","title":"何凌口中的S.H.","imagePath":"worlds/taiyi/assets/npc/avatars/LS-NPC-072.webp","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"何凌自述遭枪击后被代号S.H.的人救起并觉醒。"},{"level":2,"text":"李好不知道S.H.是谁，也没有证实与网吧TXT的落款是同一人。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-user-secret","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-necromancer","title":"死灵术士的回归","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"死灵术士被天灾逼退前，说对雷武龙有兴趣，很快会再来找他。"},{"level":2,"text":"他想让PC把数据因子进贡给他，说两人迟早会被他拿下。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-hat-wizard","audioPath":""},{"id":"ty-silver-thread","title":"银线与白发幻视","imagePath":"","folderId":"ty-folder-5","imageScale":1,"imagePositionX":50,"imagePositionY":50,"revealLevels":[{"level":1,"text":"欲子中枪濒死时经历银线与青铜祭祀幻视，看到被固定在铜柱上的年轻白发女性，面容看不清。"},{"level":2,"text":"医生解释子弹偏转、头皮枪伤与脑震荡。"}],"fallbackColor":"#6e9aa8","fallbackIcon":"fa-wave-square","audioPath":""}]
